label: Square Jeans Pocket
description: The square jeans pocket is the classic Western five-pocket front opening. The mouth drops straight down from the waistband at the side, turns a crisp squared corner, then runs inboard across the front of the leg on a shallow fall of a few degrees, finishing at the pressed front crease. That long inboard run is what makes it a jeans pocket rather than a tailored side pocket, and the squared corner is what separates it from the arc. Heavily topstitched along the opening. It is the most casual and rugged front-pocket style, signalling denim and workwear heritage rather than tailoring.
